name: Joel
overview: Joel is a male figure from the tribe of Gad, recognized as a chief among the Gadites. His leadership role highlights his significance within his tribal context, as noted in 1 Chronicles 5:12. No additional personal notes are recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Joel means 'YHWH is God [El],' reflecting a declaration of God's sovereignty. This proper name is noted in 1 Chronicles 5:12, emphasizing the theistic foundation of his identity.
familyAndRelationships: Joel is explicitly identified as a descendant of Gad, linking him directly to the tribal patriarch of the Gadites as recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:12. Scripture does not provide further family relationships beyond this tribal connection.
scriptureSignificance: Joel's significance lies primarily in his role as a chief within the tribe of Gad, indicating a position of authority and responsibility among his people. His identification as a Gadite connects him to the broader narrative of the Israelite tribes and their leaders. This highlights the importance of tribal leadership in the organization and history of Israel as preserved in the biblical record.
